findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite GroupModel documenting that it never does so; admin responses requested with subGroupsCount enabled can consequently contain a null or omitted count, and callers that unbox the result can still fail with an NPE.
findings.failure_mode: Concurrent deletion changes a guaranteed numeric result into null and exposes invalid API data to callers.
findings.impact: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite GroupModel documenting that it never does so; admin responses requested with subGroupsCount enabled can consequently contain a null or omitted count, and callers that unbox the result can still fail with an NPE.
findings.root_cause: The missing persistence delegate is translated directly into a nullable count rather than preserving the GroupModel method contract.
findings.suggested_fix: Return a non-null fallback such as 0L when the persistence model no longer exists, or remove the stale group from the result before invoking this method.
findings.title: Preserve the non-null contract of getSubGroupsCount
findings.trigger: A cached GroupAdapter is used after the underlying group has concurrently been deleted, causing modelSupplier.get() to return null.
findings.verifier_reason: Patch line 275 exists verbatim: `return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();`. GroupModel.java L296-300 documents getSubGroupsCount() as 'Never returns null'. The patch introduces a null return when modelSupplier.get() returns null (concurrent deletion), violating the documented contract. GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount calls this and sets it on GroupRepresentation, exposing null to API consumers.

pr.title: Fix NPE when accessing group concurrently

raw_findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite GroupModel documenting that it never does so; admin responses requested with subGroupsCount enabled can consequently contain a null or omitted count, and callers that unbox the result can still fail with an NPE.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Concurrent deletion changes a guaranteed numeric result into null and exposes invalid API data to callers.
raw_findings.impact: getSubGroupsCount() returns null despite GroupModel documenting that it never does so; admin responses requested with subGroupsCount enabled can consequently contain a null or omitted count, and callers that unbox the result can still fail with an NPE.
raw_findings.root_cause: The missing persistence delegate is translated directly into a nullable count rather than preserving the GroupModel method contract.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Return a non-null fallback such as 0L when the persistence model no longer exists, or remove the stale group from the result before invoking this method.
raw_findings.title: Preserve the non-null contract of getSubGroupsCount
raw_findings.trigger: A cached GroupAdapter is used after the underlying group has concurrently been deleted, causing modelSupplier.get() to return null.

raw_findings.body: The reader exits without making any group-list request, so the test passes without exercising the concurrent read/delete path it is intended to cover.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Scheduling alone can make the regression test vacuous and allow the original concurrency failure to regress undetected.
raw_findings.impact: The reader exits without making any group-list request, so the test passes without exercising the concurrent read/delete path it is intended to cover.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test starts an asynchronous reader without establishing that it has begun executing before the concurrent operation proceeds.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Use a startup latch or other synchronization primitive and wait for the reader to perform at least one request before beginning deletion.
raw_findings.title: Synchronize reader startup so the concurrency test cannot execute zero reads
raw_findings.trigger: The scheduler delays the newly created reader thread until after the main test thread has deleted all groups and set deletedAll to true.

raw_findings.body: The assertion can observe an empty list and pass before the reader records an exception produced by the concurrent deletion.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Late reader failures are recorded after the assertion and therefore do not fail the regression test.
raw_findings.impact: The assertion can observe an empty list and pass before the reader records an exception produced by the concurrent deletion.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test reads shared failure state without waiting for the thread that writes that state to terminate.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Keep a reference to the reader thread, signal it to stop, join it with a bounded timeout, and only then assert that caughtExceptions is empty.
raw_findings.title: Wait for the reader thread before asserting captured exceptions
raw_findings.trigger: A reader request is still in flight when deletedAll is set and the main test thread reaches this assertion.

raw_findings.body: deletedAll remains false and the non-daemon reader continues issuing requests indefinitely, potentially leaking into later tests or preventing the test JVM from terminating normally.
raw_findings.failure_mode: An exceptional test path leaves an unbounded background thread running.
raw_findings.impact: deletedAll remains false and the non-daemon reader continues issuing requests indefinitely, potentially leaking into later tests or preventing the test JVM from terminating normally.
raw_findings.root_cause: Reader shutdown is performed only on the successful deletion path rather than in guaranteed cleanup.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Wrap the deletion phase in try/finally, set deletedAll in the finally block, and join the retained reader thread with a timeout.
raw_findings.title: Always stop the non-daemon reader when deletion fails
raw_findings.trigger: Any group removal throws after the reader thread has started but before execution reaches this statement.

raw_findings.body: The regression test passes because it checks only thrown exceptions and does not detect the newly introduced violation of the requested subgroup-count API contract.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Incorrect but successfully serialized concurrent responses remain untested.
raw_findings.impact: The regression test passes because it checks only thrown exceptions and does not detect the newly introduced violation of the requested subgroup-count API contract.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test discards the response payload and validates only transport-level success.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Capture each returned group list and assert that every returned representation has a non-null subgroup count when the endpoint's default subGroupsCount=true behavior is used.
raw_findings.title: Assert the subgroup-count contract instead of discarding read results
raw_findings.trigger: The concurrent endpoint returns a successful response containing a null or omitted subGroupCount, as introduced by the new null fallback.

finding.trigger: The scheduler delays the newly created reader thread until after the main test thread has deleted all groups and set deletedAll to true.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that the reader exits without making any request is speculative. The test creates 100 groups and deletes them sequentially; the reader thread loops continuously. While there is no synchronization barrier, the claim that scheduling 'alone' makes the test vacuous is not proven by the patch evidence. The test may execute zero reads in edge cases but this is not a defect introduced by the patch.

finding.trigger: A reader request is still in flight when deletedAll is set and the main test thread reaches this assertion.
finding.verifier_reason: Patch line 157 exists: `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty());`. The test sets deletedAll.set(true) at line 155 and immediately asserts at 157 without joining the reader thread. The reader may still be in-flight or about to add an exception after the assertion executes, causing late failures to be missed. This is a real test gap introduced by the new test code.

finding.trigger: Any group removal throws after the reader thread has started but before execution reaches this statement.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim requires an exception during group removal before line 155. However, the test uses managedRealm.admin().groups().group(groupUuid).remove() which does not throw on missing groups (returns void). The scenario where deletedAll remains false indefinitely due to an exception is not realistic given the code structure. The reader thread also checks deletedAll.get() which would eventually terminate.

This is a stylistic/coverage enhancement request, not a bug introduced by the patch.
